accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background. Use #073B4C for text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 48x48px (preferably 60x60px for children).
accessibility.screen_reader: All images must have descriptive alt text. Buttons must have aria-labels if icon-only.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a 'SaaS for Kids' interface. It should feel like a game, not a form. Use the 'Bento' grid but make it chunky and colorful.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme: Force LIGHT MODE. Dark mode is not suitable for this specific child-focused application.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import 'Nunito' and 'Quicksand' from Google Fonts immediately.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use Framer Motion for entrance animations (pop-in effect) and success celebrations (confetti).
instructions_to_main_agent.speech_api: Use the browser's native Web Speech API (window.speechSynthesis and window.webkitSpeechRecognition). Handle errors gracefully (e.g., if microphone is not allowed).
instructions_to_main_agent.data_handling: Mock the backend calls for now if the API is not ready, but structure the frontend to expect JSON responses for exercises.

do_not: Do not use sharp corners (always rounded-xl or more).
Do not use small text (minimum 16px, preferably 18px+).
Do not use complex gradients (stick to flat colors or very subtle gradients).
must_do: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (styled to look like speech bubbles).
Ensure the 'Microphone' button is the most prominent element on the exercise screen.
